title: 23-BCV-007 — Maximum span values for joists, rafters and beams

facts.text: The variance concerns alternative joist, rafter and beam configurations in the Canadian Wood Council’s Span Book.
It permits maximum spans referenced by Article 9.23.4.2. to be determined using The Span Book (2020 Edition), ISBN 978-1-989039-06-9.
The published STANDATA does not reproduce Span Book design tables.
